div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Urban planner / analyst
[Person]
Explores the territory,
authors and compares
what-if scenarios

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Platform operator
[Person]
Loads data, launches
and watches runs,
inspects the catalogue

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reimagina
[Software System]
Ingests territorial data,
computes urban indicators,
evaluates scenario edits
against a baseline and
serves them to a web map

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Overture Maps
[External: public S3 bucket]
Buildings, places and
administrative divisions
as GeoParquet

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OpenStreetMap
[External: Overpass API]
Walking network,
fetched with osmnx

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WorldPop
[External: REST API]
Gridded population
rasters (GeoTIFF)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INEGI and CDMX portals

Marco geoestadístico (CDMX),
colonias (SIGCDMX ArcGIS)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

INEGI marco 2024, INEGI
census 2020, amenity layers
